# find_in_page

An in-app find bar for Flutter. Wrap your page and Ctrl+F highlights and scrolls to every match, in text you never wrapped and in lazy-list rows that were never built.

pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/find_in_page
source: https://github.com/Yusufihsangorgel/find_in_page

## Before you call it

AGENTS.md in the repository root is written for you. It carries the contracts that are easy to get wrong — what must be awaited or disposed, what throws and when, and the mistakes whose symptom is silence rather than an error — along with the shortest correct usage taken from a runnable example.

It also says when NOT to reach for this package. Read that part before adding the dependency.

## Layout

- `lib/` — public API
- `example/` — runnable examples
- `test/` — the suite; `dart test` (or `flutter test`) runs it
